fact: On 1 June 2026 Chad's secretary of state for telecommunications received a World Bank mission (1-5 June) reviewing the digital transformation project PATN, and said close to 500 localities still lack telecom access or have limited connectivity.
title: Numérique : le Tchad et la Banque mondiale évaluent les avancées du PATN et préparent l'après-connectivité
